control_objective: Maintain required recovery coverage using eligible and operationally available collateral.
cure_period: one business day by cash repayment or eligible collateral top-up
exit_criteria: Coverage is restored to at least 1.25x and independently reconciled

control_objective: Preserve ownership, priority, enforceability, and lender control.
cure_period: no draw availability during any deficiency
exit_criteria: Ownership, first priority, enforceability, and lender control are all verified

control_objective: Keep the collateral-to-bank repayment route tested and within the approved time.
cure_period: availability suspended until a successful test
exit_criteria: A complete route test finishes within four hours with reconciled proceeds

control_objective: Maintain borrowing-entity liquidity available for primary repayment.
cure_period: five business days to deliver a remediation plan; availability remains frozen
exit_criteria: Unrestricted cash is at least $25 million or a documented waiver is approved

control_objective: Detect deterioration against the approved operating cash forecast and use of proceeds.
threshold: no >20% adverse variance to approved forecast
cure_period: five business days to provide an updated forecast and action plan
response_sla: next scheduled review; immediate if runway is affected
exit_criteria: Rating and repayment analysis are refreshed and the decision owner accepts the remediation plan

control_objective: Prevent unapproved secured debt or liens from weakening repayment or priority.
metric: Additional secured debt or lien creation
cure_period: none unless expressly waived in writing
exit_criteria: The lien is released or subordinated, or an authorized written waiver is effective

control_objective: Keep the facility within single-name and shared-risk concentration capacity.
cure_period: no draw may create or increase a breach
exit_criteria: Pro forma concentration headroom is non-negative after the approved draw amount

control_objective: Ensure complete and timely financial, collateral, and covenant reporting.
threshold: within 15 business days after month end
response_sla: within five business days after notice
exit_criteria: The reporting package is complete, reconciled, and accepted by credit administration
